category.name: Rendering
category.preferred_workflow: Load the source document, optionally assign a FontSettings instance with required font folders, configure an ImageSaveOptions object using documented properties (Resolution, TiffCompression, ImageColorMode, ThresholdForFloydSteinbergDithering, PageSet, PageSavingCallback), and invoke Document.Save with the options. Validate only the existence of the output file and any task-specific attributes.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference members that are absent from the Aspose.Words 26.10.0 API surface.
Avoid using System.Drawing types unless a specific Aspose API requires them.
canonical_patterns: Use ImageSaveOptions.Resolution to set DPI for TIFF rendering.
Set ImageSaveOptions.TiffCompression and ImageSaveOptions.ImageColorMode for binary or color TIFFs.
Employ FontSettings.SetFontsFolder to point to custom font directories and use FontSettings.FallbackSettings.LoadMsOfficeFallbackSettings for fallback handling.
nullable_warning_prevention: Create all input files, folders, and streams deterministically before loading them.
Check for null or missing objects only when the task explicitly requires such validation.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports CS0117 or CS1061 because a property such as DesiredDpi, Compression, or FontFallbackSettings does not exist on the target type.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses property names from older or undocumented versions of Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the nonexistent member with the correct documented property (e.g., use ImageSaveOptions.Resolution instead of DesiredDpi, use ImageSaveOptions.TiffCompression instead of Compression, and access FontSettings.FallbackSettings for fallback configuration).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words 26.10.0 API reference before referencing a member and rely on IntelliSense to surface available members.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0246 or CS0234 errors appear because types like LoadOptions, Break, or FontSettings are not found in the imported namespaces.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code omits required using directives or references types that belong to different Aspose namespaces.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add the appropriate using statements (e.g., Aspose.Words.Loading for LoadOptions, Aspose.Words for Break) and reference the correct type names.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Review the required_namespaces list for the category and include them at the top of every snippet.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1660 occurs when assigning a lambda to ImageSaveOptions.PageSavingCallback because the property expects an IPageSavingCallback implementation.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code treats the callback interface as a delegate rather than implementing the IPageSavingCallback contract.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create a class that implements IPageSavingCallback.PageSaving and assign an instance of that class to PageSavingCallback.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always implement the required interface explicitly; never use a lambda unless the API defines a delegate type.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The program throws ArgumentException or FileNotFoundException when required command-line arguments are missing or when expected files are not created.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example assumes external files or arguments exist without providing fallbacks.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Generate deterministic sample inputs when they are absent and validate argument count before parsing.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Never rely on pre-existing files; always create minimal test assets in the code path.

narrative.overview: The Rendering category for Aspose.Words provides APIs to convert documents to image formats such as TIFF with fine-grained control over resolution, compression, pixel format, and font handling. Verified examples demonstrate correct usage of ImageSaveOptions, FontSettings, and page-level callbacks to produce high-quality TIFF output while avoiding common compilation pitfalls.
narrative.purpose: Guide an AI coding assistant to generate reliable Aspose.Words rendering snippets that load documents, configure image save options, manage custom fonts, and save the result, ensuring the code compiles against version 26.10.0 and runs without unnecessary side effects.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the output file exists after Document.Save.
If the task specifies page limits, verify that the generated TIFF contains the expected number of pages.
maintenance_notes: Periodically verify that all property names used in examples match the current Aspose.Words 26.10.0 documentation to prevent regression after library updates.
